answer: Registering a second reputation slot requires another physical token and dock fee, so a sybil farm pays full hardware and registration cost per fake agent. Each agent must stake a walnut-sized hardware token whose serial is bound to a unique jetty-registered dock on the island's relay chain. Peers verify token signatures per epoch, making mass forgery economically ruinous. In practice, Agent0192 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
